subject: meta: handle 0 concurrency in IterAllTables (#64466)
summary: IterAllTables now clamps `concurrency` to [1,15], preventing divide-by-zero/panic in `splitRangeInt64Max` when callers pass 0 (e.g., `runtime.NumCPU()/2` on 1C machines); adds regression coverage for 0/negative concurrency. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/consistency/concurrency behavior, and upstream/master retains the same logic.
